AMIStatus.description: AMIStatus compares the AMI that a nodegroup runs with the latest recommended AMI for its Kubernetes version and AMI type.

status.description: status is the EKS status, such as ACTIVE or DEGRADED.

health.description: health is the status as one of a closed set of values.

latest.description: latest is the newest compatible version, in a document that reads it.

configuration.description: configuration is the configuration values of the add-on, as the JSON or YAML text that EKS returns.

issues.description: issues are the health issues that EKS reports for the add-on.

incomplete.description: incomplete is true when the add-on could not be read. Its failure is in the failures list of the document.

Addon.description: Addon is one installed EKS add-on. A key is left out when its data was not read: an add-on that could not be described has its name and incomplete.

AddonHealth.description: AddonHealth is the health of an add-on, from its EKS status.

version.description: version is left out when EKS publishes no compatible version.

behind.description: behind is true when the installed version is older than Version.

AddonLatest.description: AddonLatest is the newest version of an add-on that is compatible with the Kubernetes version of its cluster.

status.description: status is the EKS status, such as ACTIVE or UPDATING.

version.description: version is the Kubernetes minor version, such as "1.33".

upgradePolicy.description: upgradePolicy is the EKS support type, STANDARD or EXTENDED.

healthIssues.description: healthIssues are the control-plane issues that EKS reports.

support.description: support is the support window of the Kubernetes version, in a document that reads it.

compute.description: compute says how the cluster runs its nodes, in a document that reads it. It is left out when that could not be found out.

nodegroups.description: nodegroups are the managed nodegroups, in a document that reads them.

addons.description: addons are the installed add-ons, in a document that reads them.

incomplete.description: incomplete is true when part of the row could not be read. The failures of the row are in the failures list of the document.

Cluster.description: Cluster is one EKS cluster. A key is left out when its data was not read: a row that could not be read at all has its name, its region, and incomplete.

ComputeType.description: ComputeType says how a cluster runs its nodes.

name.description: name identifies the item. For a Region failure it is the region.

cluster.description: cluster is the cluster that the item belongs to.

operation.description: operation is the IAM action that failed, such as "eks:DescribeNodegroup".

retryable.description: retryable reports whether the same command, run again with no other change, may succeed.

error.description: error is one line of text for people. Do not parse it; use Reason.

awsErrorCode.description: awsErrorCode is the AWS API error code, such as AccessDeniedException, when AWS answered.

updateId.description: updateId is the EKS update ID, for a failure of a started update.

Failure.description: Failure is one item that refresh could not read, or one action that it tried and that did not complete.

FailureKind.description: FailureKind is the type of item a Failure is about.

Failures.description: Failures is the failure list of a document. A nil list encodes as [], so a document always has its failures key as a list.

state.description: state is the EC2 instance state, such as running.

Instance.description: Instance is an EC2 instance of a nodegroup.

Issue.description: Issue is a health issue that EKS reports for a resource.

vpcCidr.description: vpcCidr is the CIDR block of the VPC, in a document that reads it.

publicAccess.description: publicAccess and PrivateAccess say how the API server endpoint can be reached.

Network.description: Network is the VPC configuration of a cluster.

status.description: status is the EKS status, such as ACTIVE or UPDATING.

version.description: version is the Kubernetes minor version of the nodegroup.

versionBehind.description: versionBehind is true when the nodegroup runs an older minor version than the control plane. It is left out when one of the two versions is not known.

amiType.description: amiType is the EKS AMI type, such as AL2023_x86_64_STANDARD.

releaseVersion.description: releaseVersion is the AMI release version of the nodegroup.

capacityType.description: capacityType is the EKS capacity type, such as ON_DEMAND or SPOT.

healthIssues.description: healthIssues are the issues that EKS reports for the nodegroup.

instances.description: instances are the EC2 instances of the nodegroup, in a document that reads them.

incomplete.description: incomplete is true when part of the nodegroup could not be read. Its failures are in the failures list of the document.

Nodegroup.description: Nodegroup is one EKS managed nodegroup. A key is left out when its data was not read: a nodegroup that could not be described has its name and incomplete.

current.description: current is the ID of the AMI that the nodes run. It is left out for a nodegroup with no instance to read.

latest.description: latest is the ID of the latest recommended AMI. It is left out for an AMI type that has none.

currentCreatedAt.description: currentCreatedAt is when the current AMI was created. "refresh status" reads it for an outdated AMI.

NodegroupAMI.description: NodegroupAMI is the AMI of a nodegroup and how it compares with the latest recommended one.

Scaling.description: Scaling is the scaling configuration of a nodegroup.

kmsKeyArn.description: kmsKeyArn is the key that encrypts secrets. It is left out when secrets are not encrypted with a KMS key.

logTypes.description: logTypes are the enabled control-plane log types.

Security.description: Security is the security configuration of a cluster.

daysRemaining.description: daysRemaining is the days until the tier ends, with a part of a day as a whole day. It is left out when no window is open.

autoUpgrade.description: autoUpgrade is true when the upgrade policy of the cluster is STANDARD: EKS upgrades it at the end of standard support, and it never enters extended support.

builtIn.description: builtIn is true when the dates are the ones that refresh ships with, because EKS did not report them.

Support.description: Support is the support window of the Kubernetes version of a cluster.

SupportTier.description: SupportTier is where the Kubernetes version of a cluster is in its EKS support window.

apiVersion.description: The version of the document contract.

skippedRegions.description: skippedRegions are the regions of a default sweep that are closed to these credentials. They are not failures. The key is left out when the regions were named.

failures.description: Every failure of the run: the items that refresh could not read and the actions that did not complete. The list is sorted by kind, region, cluster, name, and operation. It is [] when there are no failures.

title: FleetStatus
description: The document that `refresh status -o json` prints. -o yaml prints the same structure.
